name: find2fd
description: Accelerate qualified GNU find searches with a native Rust traversal engine while preserving GNU fallback.

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:integration && node tools/verify.mjs
scripts.test:core: npm run test:rust && npm run test:integration && node tools/verify.mjs --core
scripts.test:deep: npm run test:rust && npm run test:integration && node tools/verify.mjs --deep
scripts.test:rust: npm run test:rust:unit && npm run test:rust:oracle
scripts.test:rust:oracle: npm run build:rust && FIND2FD_RUST_BINARY="$PWD/rust/target/release/find2fd-rust" cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --target-dir rust/target/oracle-tests --features release-oracle --test gnu_oracle -- --nocapture
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:rust && node --test tests/test_find_rust_routing.mjs tests/test_benchmark_processes.mjs tests/test_verification_evidence.mjs
